name: tabxel
description: HTML table -> Excel (XLSX) converter. WASM core (rust_xlsxwriter) with a thin JS binding; ships as a single CDN-loadable ESM.

scripts.build:opt: wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals --enable-reference-types pkg/tabxel_bg.wasm -o pkg/tabxel_bg.wasm || echo 'wasm-opt step skipped/failed; continuing with unoptimized wasm'
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:bindgen && npm run build:opt && npm run build:bundle
